bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature that evaluates cognitive biases in LLM-assisted decision-making tasks using frameworks like BIASBUSTER and self-debiasing techniques that automatically adjust prompts to remove bias-inducing elements.

Reviewing studies that simulate political debates with multi-agent frameworks to observe how agents converge towards models' inherent biases, and evaluating calibration frameworks in stance detection.
Reviewing studies that audit and mitigate cultural bias using human-in-the-loop approaches, cultural prompting as a control strategy, and evaluations based on the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map.
Reviewing literature that quantifies gender bias and stereotyping in LLMs through prompt-based evaluation methods.
